Ps Wadki ... on 11 October, 2021

Author: Vinay Joshi
Bench: V. G. Joshi
Order 
 1
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur.
 Criminal Application (Aba) No. 677/2021.
 Balwan singh Shreenandlal Chowdary.
 -Versus-
 State of Maharashtra, through P.S. Wadki, Tq. Ralegaon, District Yavatmal.

 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:

and Registrar's orders
Shri S.A. Mohta, Advocate for the Applicant.
Shri A. Chutke, A.P.P. for the Non-applicant.

Coram : Vinay Joshi, J.
Date : October 11, 2021 Heard.
2.

In anticipation of arrest in Crime No.219/2021 registered with the non-applicant Wadki Police Station, Tq. Ralegaon, District Yavatmal for the offence punishable under Sections 272, 273, 328,
188, 269, 270 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 30[2][a], 26 and 29 of the Food and Safety Standard Act, the applicant is seeking pre-arrest protection.
The applicant also seeks for ad-interim pre- arrest protection.

3. It is the prosecution case that on receipt of secret information, the police had intercepted a truck at Order 1110aba677.21 Yavatmal containing huge quantity of banned Gutka articles worth Rs.46 lakhs.
The driver as well as the cleaner of the concerned truck came to be arrested on the spot.
4. The applicant is the registered owner of the said truck.
It is submitted that the applicant has leased out the said truck for a period of one year under notarized lease deed dated 01.07.2021, to the driver of the truck namely Guddu.

On the basis of said lease deed, the control of the truck was Balwan Singh Shreenandlal Chowdary vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps Wadki ... on 11 October, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192254311/
1 assigned to Guddu for a period of one year on contract, on paying Rs.30,000/- per month.

sentences.text: On that basis, it is submitted that the applicant had no knowledge about the goods being transported by the truck, nor he has any sort of involvement in the alleged crime.

5. The learned counsel for the applicant took me through the statements of driver and cleaner,
which are reproduced by the trial Court while dealing with bail application of both the co-accused.

It is brought to the notice that they have stated that the contraband articles namely Gutka were owned by one Deepak Kothari of Karnataka State and were about to deliver to one Dwarkrprasad of Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh.
Statements Order 1110aba677.21 also convey that one Abdul Kavi was controlling the affairs.
Prima facie, applicants involvement is not evidence for which it is necessary to go through the case diary.
6. Having regard to these peculiar facts, applicant's liberty can be protected till the matter is heard on merits.
Hence, the following order.
(i) Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable on 15.11.2021.
Learned A.P.P. waives notice for the non-applicant.

(ii) In the meanwhile, in the event of arrest of the applicant/accused Balwan Singh Shreenandlal Chowdary in connection with Crime No.219/2021 registered with the non- applicant Wadki Police Station, Tq. Ralegaon, District Yavatmal for the offence punishable under Sections 272, 273, 328, 188, 269, 270 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 30[2][a], 26 and 29 of the Food and Safety Standard Act, he be released on interim bail on his furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like amount.

entities.text: Wadki Police Station, Tq. Ralegaon, District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Order 1110aba677.
(iii) The applicant/accused to attend  concerned police station on every Sunday in between 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. till further orders.
(iv) The applicant/accused shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.

JUDGE Rgd.
